# temps_ai_project_limits (Resource)

AI gateway limits for one project, overriding the instance limits. Destroying the resource removes the override.

Import with `<project_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `ai_gateway:read`, `ai_gateway:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_ai_project_limits" "web" {
  project_id              = temps_project.web.id
  max_requests_per_minute = 60
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `max_cost_per_month_microcents` (Number) Spend per calendar month in millionths of a cent; unset means no limit.
- `max_requests_per_minute` (Number) Requests per minute; unset means no limit.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>
terraform import temps_ai_project_limits.web 8
```
